prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Sync Guarantee Callout: Display a prominent reassurance banner explaining that signing in permanently links your pet to your account across reinstalls. (why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, causing anxiety during authentication.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Control Quick Guide Screen: Add a dedicated post-onboarding desktop quick-guide screen showing how to talk to, summon, hide, and right-click your pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion about controlling or hiding pets, and the finish step has a low 64.8% completion rate.)
2: [home, new_flow] Waiting Screen Desktop Companion Mini-Game: Transform the waiting screen into an interactive play area where users can pet an animated companion mascot while generation finishes. (why: The waiting step has a long 2336s mean time, and 3 users reported pets failing to appear or users quitting prematurely.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Trouble Direct Support Hint: Add an instant fallback helper button and explicit status hint on the sign-in screen if loading stalls. (why: Support received emails about sign-in screen failing to appear or stalling before authentication.)
4: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray & Voice Controls Primer: Add an explicit system notification preference toggle and tray control guide component during final onboarding step. (why: Multiple users sent support requests confused about hiding, moving, or communicating with desktop pets.)
